tools.get_spec_implementation: the code that implements a spec
tools.quick_orient: a symbol's or the project's overview in one call
tools.read_unit: a symbol's body, what it calls and the tests that cover it
tools.sync_openspec: read openspec/ specs and changes into the index

hints.debug-repro: find the failing symbol (find_symbol), then who_calls and analyze_impact before changing it
hints.debug-unclear: map the path first: who_calls, who_does_this_call and analyze_impact on every suspect
hints.implement: before editing a symbol, who_calls and analyze_impact; get_spec_implementation for the spec it serves
hints.feature: list_specs and get_spec_implementation for what exists; analyze_impact on each symbol you change
hints.refactor: who_calls on every symbol you move or rename; find_dead_code for what can go
hints.ui: find_symbol for the component; who_calls to see where it renders
hints.test: audit_coverage and find_orphan_tests to see what is untested; get_symbol_source to read the target
hints.review-routine: git_diff_impact on the change; analyze_impact on anything it touches
hints.review-critical: git_diff_impact on the change; analyze_impact and get_spec_implementation for every spec it touches
hints.explore: quick_orient for the overview, then search and find_symbol
hints.plan: quick_orient, list_specs and analyze_impact on the parts the plan changes
